general.title: GSEA Enrichment Plot Generator
general.instructions:
Generate enrichment plots from a filtered GSEA results table and a DEG table.

**Required inputs:**
1. **GSEA Filter Results** — filtered pathway table (CSV or RDS from OMIX GSEA Filter)
2. **DEG Table** — differential expression results (CSV or RDS)

**Optional inputs for LE heatmaps:**
3. **Normalized Expression** — expression matrix (CSV or RDS, genes × samples)
4. **Sample Metadata** — annotations (CSV or RDS)

**Column mapping:** Set the column name fields below if your files use names other than the defaults.

Uploaded files always take priority over attached data assets.

parameters.name: GSEA Filter Results File
parameters.help_text: Upload filtered GSEA results table. Takes priority over the attached data asset.

parameters.help_text: Upload DEG table. Takes priority over the attached data asset.

parameters.name: Normalized Expression File
parameters.help_text: Upload normalized expression matrix (CSV or RDS, genes × samples). Required for LE heatmaps.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.help_text: Upload sample metadata file. Required for LE heatmaps.

parameters.name: LE heatmap gene column
parameters.help_text: Column name for gene identifiers in the expression table (default: gene).

parameters.name: LE heatmap sample column
parameters.help_text: Column name for sample identifiers in the metadata table (default: Sample).

parameters.name: LE heatmap group column
parameters.help_text: Column name for sample grouping in the metadata table (default: Group). Used to color heatmap columns.

parameters.name: Panels to include
parameters.help_text:
Select which panels to include in each plot.

ES — Running score (enrichment score curve)
RNK — Ranked gene list (gene score distribution)
LE — Leading edge heatmap (requires expression data)

parameters.name: Contrast filter mode
parameters.help_text:
none — include all contrasts (default)
keep — include only the contrasts listed below
remove — include all contrasts except those listed below

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.help_text:
Comma-separated contrast names for keep/remove mode.
Example: Treatment_vs_Control,Drug_vs_Vehicle

Ignored when Contrast filter mode is set to none.

parameters.name: Top pathways per contrast/collection
parameters.help_text:
Number of top-ranked pathways to plot within each contrast × collection group.
0 = plot all pathways.

parameters.name: Total plots in PDF
parameters.help_text:
Global ceiling on the total number of plots written to the PDF, applied after per-group selection.
0 = no limit.
The run log warns when more than 50 plots are about to be generated.

parameters.name: PDF page width
parameters.help_text: PDF page width in inches.

parameters.name: PDF page height
parameters.help_text: PDF page height in inches.

parameters.name: Running score line color
parameters.help_text:
Color of the running enrichment score curve.

red/blue by ES — red for positive ES (upregulated pathway), blue for negative ES (downregulated)
green — fixed green color regardless of ES direction

Title text and guide lines are always black.

parameters.name: Max deviation guide line
parameters.help_text:
Dashed guide line at the maximum enrichment score point.

x-coordinate: vertical line at the gene rank (x-axis) of the peak ES.
y-coordinate: horizontal line at the ES value (y-axis) of the peak ES.
xy-coordinate: crosshair — both lines together.
none: no guide line.

parameters.name: RNK area fill color
parameters.help_text:
Fill color for the gene score area in the RNK panel.

grey — neutral grey fill regardless of pathway direction.
red_blue — red for positive scores, blue for negative scores, matching the ES strip coloring.

parameters.name: LE heatmap transform
parameters.help_text: Transform expression values before drawing the leading-edge heatmap.

parameters.name: Max LE genes in heatmap
parameters.help_text: Caps each leading-edge heatmap to keep preview and PDF pages readable.

parameters.name: Cluster LE heatmap rows
parameters.help_text: Apply hierarchical clustering to heatmap rows (genes).

parameters.name: Cluster LE heatmap columns
parameters.help_text: Apply hierarchical clustering to heatmap columns (samples).

parameters.name: Show LE heatmap gene names
parameters.help_text: Display gene symbols on heatmap rows.

parameters.name: Show LE heatmap sample names
parameters.help_text: Display sample names on heatmap columns.

parameters.name: Prefix LE heatmap genes with LE# rank
parameters.help_text: Adds within-leading-edge ranks to heatmap row labels, e.g. LE#1 Myc. Rank 1 is the strongest up or down leading-edge gene for that pathway.

parameters.name: Order LE heatmap rows by LE# rank
parameters.help_text: Shows strongest leading-edge genes first. When enabled, row clustering is disabled so rank order is preserved.
